headline: GTA VI generates $3.79 billion on its debut: how did it break sales records?
summary: Rockstar Games' GTA VI reportedly earned $3.79 billion at launch, after 32.5 million copies were sold before release. The debut followed a 13-year buildup and a promotional campaign that extended to Netflix.
why: Take-Two Interactive is the publisher behind Rockstar Games, so the title's sales performance directly affects its revenue outlook and investor expectations for its flagship franchise.
original_headline: GTA VI genera 3,790 millones de dólares en su estreno: ¿cómo consiguió romper récords de ventas?
